# Tinlance

> Public repository index for the Tinlance AI engineering, FDE, security, automation, API, and customer-platform codebase. The repository is public for engineering transparency and is proprietary; public visibility does not grant an open-source reuse license.

## Start here

- [README](README.md): Repository purpose, architecture, local setup, security boundaries, and contribution guidance.
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): Development workflow and pull-request requirements.
- [Security](SECURITY.md): Private vulnerability reporting and security baseline.
- [Support](SUPPORT.md): Issue and support routing.
- [Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md): Participation and enforcement policy.
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md): Repository and documentation history.
- [Documentation index](docs/README.md): Diátaxis-oriented navigation across the existing documentation set.

## Authority boundaries

- FDE Mastery remains the methodology and execution-platform authority for FDE capabilities.
- Tinlance remains the public commercial and customer-facing platform.
- The FDE API is the authenticated service boundary between them.
- M7 is the authorization/security control plane; M6 is the MCP/tool boundary; M8 is evaluation authority; M9 is controlled agent execution.
- Evidence status distinguishes implementation, testing, validation, experimentation, and planning.
